# Finaloop

> Real-time ecommerce accounting software and services for DTC, multichannel, and wholesale sellers with automated bookkeeping, tax compliance, inventory tracking, and fractional CFO support.

Finaloop provides Big 4-trained accounting expertise combined with software automation for ecommerce brands. The platform integrates real-time financial visibility, COGS accuracy, and tax services to help sellers scale profitably across channels like Shopify and beyond.

## Key Topics

- Ecommerce Accounting
- Bookkeeping Software
- Real-time P&L
- Cash Flow Management
- COGS Tracking
- Tax Services
- Inventory IQ
- Fractional CFO
- Financial Reporting
- Accounting Automation
- DTC Brands
- Shopify Integration
- Financial Dashboard
- Tax Compliance
- Customer Success

## Core Products & Services

- [How Brands Use Finaloop's Software](https://www.finaloop.com/product): Finaloop's core bookkeeping software with real-time P&L, cash flow, and automated reconciliation.
- [Inventory IQ Product](https://www.finaloop.com/inventory-iq-product): InventoryIQ: real-time inventory tracking, COGS accuracy, and profitability insights.
- [How Brands Use Finaloop's Services](https://www.finaloop.com/services): Finaloop's full-service bookkeeping, tax, and fractional CFO offerings for ecommerce.
- [Fractional CFO](https://www.finaloop.com/fractional-cfo): Finaloop's Fractional CFO service for expert financial management and business growth.
- [Tax Services](https://www.finaloop.com/additional-cpa-services): Finaloop's CPA-integrated tax services for ecommerce compliance and tax preparation.
